official_semantics.backpack_history: Backpack official public GET /api/v1/fundingRates returns symbol intervalEndTimestamp and fundingRate with explicit limit default 100 maximum 10000 and offset default zero.
official_semantics.backpack_instruments: Backpack official public GET /api/v1/markets exposes symbol baseSymbol quoteSymbol marketType fundingInterval orderBookState createdAt and visible.
official_semantics.backpack_cash_flow: Backpack official funding terms state the current settlement cycle is one hour and positive funding is paid by longs to shorts while negative funding is paid by shorts to longs.
official_semantics.backpack_settlement: Backpack official futures specifications state markets are denominated and settled in USDC and funding payment equals funding rate times position quantity times mark price.
official_semantics.binance_cash_flow: The retained source-bound Binance convention is positive funding paid by longs to shorts with BTCUSDT ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT eight-hour events validated by exact schedule.
official_semantics.execution_hurdle: The funding-only prefilter charges 20 bips round trip plus explicit ten-percent annual two-leg capital 25-bip USDC-USDT and 25-bip custody-latency-failure hurdles before any basis or book request.

pagination_plan.decision: One fixed recent page per asset must contain every exact required hourly timestamp. No second offset page alias or changed limit is allowed after access.

orientation: Choose sign once from the training aggregate of Backpack hourly-summed funding minus Binance funding. Positive fixes short Backpack and long Binance; negative fixes long Backpack and short Binance. Never refit validation or test.

decision.failure: Terminalize the exact 270-bin population before premiums books accounts credentials orders or funds; do not resample alter roles orientation alignment costs limit or offset.
decision.survivor: Freeze exact current venue fees and synchronized finite-size entry and exit basis and depth evidence. A survivor is not yet an accepted edge or deployment-ready.

retry_policy: One exact inventory GET and one exact fixed Backpack and Binance funding GET per asset only. Preserve every response. Never paginate alias reorder narrow change limit or offset substitute a host or retry after seeing values.
